ops.text: evidence 4: release-assets failed silently in .github/scripts/verify-release-archives.sh because its Mach-O assertions were written against macOS `file` wording ("Mach-O 64-bit executable x86_64") while GNU libmagic on the ubuntu runner prints "Mach-O 64-bit x86_64 executable"; grep -Fq under set -e exited without a message. Fixed in a3bed8e with a word-order-independent check that reports the actual description. Second lint-linux run (fe7ba24) left two gosec G703 findings in Linux-only test lines (the first nolint sat on the MkdirAll line, not the WriteFile line; supervise_linux_test.go had none); fixed on the next head. The macOS `test` job passed again on fe7ba24.
